text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I approached it with the best theory possible at the moment.
And yet... the lead was still so far away...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What on earth was lacking?
Where did I go wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What... what should I do...?
...No good, I can't gather my thoughts properly...
choice_data_list: You're thinking too hard about this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What... what should I do...?
...No good, I can't gather my thoughts properly...
choice_data_list: You're thinking too hard about this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's fine... It's fine.
If it's just nonsense meant to comfort me—
—I look into her wavering, anxious eyes and nod.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If it's me, I can fix it, huh?
...Right. That's true.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your advice is one of the pillars supporting my theory.
It has been until now, and will be going forward... In that case—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must prove that nonsense right.
With my victory...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"My head is an average size! There's nothing wrong with it!
Nothing wrong at all, and yet—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“...Indeed,
I may have let theory get too far ahead of practice.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I was probably just running the race in my head,
even though my opponent was right in front of me."
choice_data_list: Let's not rush and just keep at it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
Your words have cleared away the fog before my eyes.
